scripts.dev: npm run build -w @borrowcircle/shared && concurrently -k -n database,api,web,shared "npm run dev:db -w @borrowcircle/server" "npm run dev -w @borrowcircle/server" "npm run dev -w @borrowcircle/client" "npm run watch -w @borrowcircle/shared"
scripts.dev:external: npm run build -w @borrowcircle/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web,shared "npm run dev -w @borrowcircle/server" "npm run dev -w @borrowcircle/client" "npm run watch -w @borrowcircle/shared"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @borrowcircle/shared && npm run build -w @borrowcircle/server && npm run build -w @borrowcircle/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @borrowcircle/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
